title: Elixir of Cloud Giant Strength
summary: Drink as a Bonus Action to raise Strength to 27 until your next Long Rest. Throw as an Action to apply the effect in a 3 ft radius for 10 turns.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle for Strength 27 until your next Long Rest. Replaces active elixir effects on affected creatures.
fields.Throw: Action. Consume one bottle. Affects all creatures in a 3 ft radius for 10 turns. Replaces active elixir effects on affected creatures.
fields.Stacking: Either use replaces other elixir effects on affected creatures.
fields.Crafting: Combine Salts of Cloud Giant Fingernails with any Suspension.
fields.Creative use: Save the splash for a group that can use the Strength boost right away. Keep enemies out of range.
fields.Base value: 160 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added source-reviewed native BG3 gameplay, consumption, and crafting details.
